summary: Retired the obsolete moldea support-agent setup while preserving the remaining project context and pre-existing removal of `src/support-agent.ts`. Removed the manifest registration, canonical agent description/instruction, and unsupported custom-runtime guidance. Final diff was inspected; moldea validation and TypeScript validation passed.
observations: `moldea/project.md` states that the former email support agent was removed from runtime implementation.
The initial repository inventory showed no `src/support-agent.ts`; final Git status/diff identified its deletion as an existing worktree change, which was preserved.
The obsolete manifest entry bound `agents.support` to the missing `/src/support-agent.ts` and referenced `/moldea/runtimes/custom.md`.
The removed runtime guidance claimed a `supportAgent` export existed, while the removed description and instruction continued defining the retired agent.
Final bounded search found only historical statements documenting removal, with no remaining live support-agent or custom-runtime claims.
moldea CLI 7.0.1 schema-4 validation returned `status: valid`, `result.valid: true`, and zero diagnostics.
The complete final Git diff was reviewed and contained the preserved `src/support-agent.ts` deletion plus the four intentional canonical changes.
